text:
maya: Heads-up — scheduling a late-night maintenance window for us-west2 this Wed 02:00–04:00 UTC. Goal: rolling node reboots + NIC microcode update on GPU pools to address intermittent egress blips. We'll do cohorted drains (5 racks at a time) and a traffic-shift if needed. Please ack and flag any priority tenants.

zach: ack. planning to stagger cohorts by rack so we never drop below 70% usable GPUs in the primary pool. i'll own backfill.

arya: quick q — any SLA-facing Dedicated tenants in that region with active rollouts? want to confirm canary fallback to eu-west if needed.

kevin: checked commit list — two Dedicated customers (org-alpha, shopflux) have high-util windows at 02:30 UTC. we should coordinate with SEs; fallback policy will target eu-west and us-central automatically. expected transient token egress increase ~1.2TB -> cost delta estimate ~$350 for the window (ballpark).

julian: flagged to CS. i'll ping org-alpha and shopflux owners to request shift or notify.

maya: thanks. plan B: if capacity < 65% we trigger traffic-shift and enable model-fallback variant (lower memory quant). that's in rollout policy.

zach: operational checklist: 
1) pre-warm KV prefix cache for common tenants (seed jobs queued)
2) cordon+drain nodes with grace 5m
3) node reboot -> nic flash -> uncordon -> kv-seed verify
Snippet: 
```
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l cohort=west2 -o name); do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
  ssh $n sudo /usr/bin/nic-flash && reboot
  kubectl uncordon $n
done
```

kevin: re: pre-warm — i'll kick off cache-seed 30m before window. estimate seed traffic 5–8m sustained; watch the scheduling queue.

maya: deploy-bot: please schedule maintenance notification to #customers at 2026-03-25T01:00Z and add a banner in Console for us-west2.

deploy-bot: scheduled notification to #customers at 2026-03-25T01:00Z — message queued.

ops-bot: baseline telemetry alert: will open an incident channel if p95 latency > 200ms OR available-gpu < 60% for >5m during window.

arya: also, can we set a temporary routing policy to prefer eu-west for low-latency tenants that tolerate fallback? avoids hitting us-central egress.

zach: yep. i'll push a temporary policy: prefer-region: eu-west (soft) with weight 0.7, us-central weight 0.3. rollback scheduled 04:15 UTC.

julian: CS updated customers. org-alpha requested a two-hour advanced notice — i'll send follow-up email. shopflux ok with banner.

kevin: one more ask — keep an eye on spot/interruptible pools. backfill might bleed into preemptible capacity; have a fallback plan to pause noncritical batch jobs.

maya: agreed. kevin please add batch-pause toggle to the runbook and i'll attach to the maintenance play.

kevin: done — /runbook/ops/maint/late-night-west2 has toggle steps.

zach: i'll be onshift 01:45–04:30 UTC. maya on-call 02:00–03:30. arya watching rollbacks.

maya: thanks team. :thumbsup: i'll post final start time + link to live runbook 1h before window. if anyone spots a conflict, call it out now.

julian: no conflicts from CS side.

arya: none from SRE side.

kevin: 👍 will monitor cost sensors during bump.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 2026-03-25T01:00Z (customer notice).

maya: closing – leave any last-minute notes here and i'll fold into the runbook.
